quality.numeric_confidence_policy: Secondary reproduction explicitly attributed to Environment Agency Pollution Inventory 2024 under OGL is capped at confidence 98 until a direct official raw PI row is read.
quality.year_policy: Only explicit 2024-column or definitive single-year 2024 Air annual-mass rows may be promoted.
quality.adjacent_year_policy: Blank 2024 and populated 2025 is 2025-only and is never backfilled.
quality.apr_policy: APR annual masses are crosschecks only and are never silently substituted for PI rows.

official_source_paths.retrieval: Known official 2024 PI ZIP path retained; identical known binary-client failure was not loop-retried and no direct row is claimed.
